items.name: burning-screen
items.title: Burning-Screen
items.description: One click burns the screen away from where you clicked and shows the next page through the hole. Save it for one big moment, like finishing sign-up.

items.name: agent-draw
items.title: Agent-Draw
items.description: Named cursors draw your page's skeleton while its data loads, then the real content fades in. Use it on slow screens, like a dashboard or profile.

items.name: brain-txt
items.title: brain.txt
items.description: A web of dots around a brain, each dot a thought to hover, open and drag. Use it on an about or portfolio page with 8 to 20 short thoughts.

items.name: scratch-me
items.title: Scratch-me
items.description: A scratch-off foil hides a promo code that copies itself once revealed. Use it on a pricing, upgrade or thank-you page for one special offer.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password-Strength
items.description: A password field that rates what you type as No, AI, AI agent or Human. Use it on sign-up and reset forms in place of a plain strength bar.

items.name: framed-upload
items.title: Framed-Upload
items.description: Drop in a picture and it hangs in a frame with a soft shadow, like a print on a wall. Use it on cover or portfolio forms, one picture per frame.

items.name: hex-login
items.title: Hex-Login
items.description: A calm login page with your logo inside turning hexagon rings. Use it as your main sign-in page, with your own logo and real sign-in behind it.

items.name: burning-toast
items.title: Burning-toast
items.description: Toasts that stack at the bottom of the screen and burn away when they close. Use it in apps and dashboards after a save or send, one short line each.

items.name: text-mirroring
items.title: Text-mirroring
items.description: Bold header text that echoes into an infinite glass mirror on hover. Use it on one hero or section title of two to four short words.

items.name: black-hole-refresh
items.title: Black-Hole-Refresh
items.description: A black hole pulls your page into long thin threads, swallows them and blasts the page back fresh. Use it on refresh for a playful site or portfolio.

items.name: venom-button
items.title: Venom-button
items.description: A glossy ink button whose tentacles grab your pointer and pull on it until they snap. Use it for one main action, like the call to action in a hero.

items.name: peter-tingle-button
items.title: Peter-Tingle-button
items.description: A button that feels your pointer coming and tingles, with wavy lines pulsing toward it. Use it for one main action, like a hero call to action.

items.name: ascii-tide-button
items.title: ASCII-Tide-button
items.description: A dark button that shows drifting ASCII characters behind its label and sends a calm violet tide on tap. Use it for one main action, like a hero.

items.name: glass-shatter-button
items.title: Glass-Shatter-button
items.description: A dark button in a ring of glass that glows as your pointer comes near and shatters into shards on click, then seals. Use it for one main action.

items.name: tug-of-work-loader
items.title: Tug-of-Work-loader
items.description: A see-through progress bar a tiny person hauls to 100% on a rope, straining when it waits. Use it for uploads, exports and builds that take a while.

items.name: pixel-button
items.title: Pixel-button
items.description: A button with twinkling pixels behind its label, on hover or always on, a light circling its edge and a click wave. Use it for one main action.

items.name: peephole-button
items.title: Peephole-button
items.description: A glass button with a picture window that opens on hover into the whole image or your brand color. Use it on Contact or Gallery with a real photo.
